GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Went Forward settled down three back rail just steadying up off heels 3-4 Lengths (800m), cornered similar, couldn't run on # no run on straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped. Near the 800m, improved onto heels and steadied. Again near the 700m, improved onto heels and steadied. Held up for clear running approaching the home turn. Rdr reported mount raced very keenly and may have displaced its soft palate. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

Jumped Ok Went Forward 3 Wide of 4 early Took sit 4th 1x1 3 Lengths , enjoyed good trail Under Pressure x 400m run ended 200m - must lead?? (t/t/ag) # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Connections advised a change of tactics – attempt to secure cover. Ridden accordingly. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1 length on fence, shifted Two Wide at 750m and Moved Up to join lead approaching turn, led Two Wide jointly on the turn, took sole Lead Straightening Up , Headed 100m, kept trying to the line # battled on fairly
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 2 Lengths , held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths rail, Held Ground in Straight # Had Every Chance

Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a long head, took Lead at the 550m, went clear and led Two Wide by 2 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight and only Headed 50m from post. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted. Rider stated that his instructions were to obtain a forward position and allow it to stride freely, however he was required to pressure it early to obtain the lead, mindful of the quick early pace he was on its mouth as much as he could possibly be in attempting to control the speed whilst being mindful of instructions not to restrain it due to a history of breathing issues. His further instructions were to pinch a break leading to the home turn but it could not sustain the run. Co-Trainer confirmed the instructions adding he had observed it had sweated up noticeably behind the barriers, which with the race pace likely had an effect on the performance. Explanations noted.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest re tactics, Rdr said instruct to be forward & allow gelding to stride freely, however; was required to pressure mount early to obtain lead-said after obtaining lead near 700m, while conscious pace was quick early, was on horse’s mouth as much as possible to control speed & mindful of instructs not to restrain as gelding had a history of breathing issues-added instruct to pinch a break coming to h/turn, but could not sustain run. Co-tnr confirmed instructs to lead if possible, clarified breathing issue & advised Rdr not to restrain as can cause gelding to flip soft palate. SEE REPORT
